title: Across ~15+ fights (wolves, wights, the honour guard, the grave-wight) companions never once appear to take damage or need healing — only the player's own hp ever changes (e.g. 'The lean wolf attacks. (hp-2)'), and `status` never lists a hp value for any companion, only regard (e.g. 'Party: Vell (regard +1), Tamsin (regard +7)'). This makes it impossible to actually 'watch who gets hit' or see whether resting at an inn mends a companion.
where: any combat, e.g. Barrow Crypt (barrow-wight) / The Kings' Rest — Hall (honour guard) / status command
